description: Block until selected Codex workers reach a terminal status, then return summaries. Each call is capped at 60 seconds unless allowLongWait is explicitly true and the caller has verified its MCP timeout supports the requested budget. A spent wait budget returns a snapshot while workers continue; reuse the same task_ids or schedule check_workers for longer monitoring. compact: true returns one line per worker with status, phase, exit_code, changed_file_count, acceptance and liveness. command_running means a command may still be working despite a long idle interval.
name: wait_codex_workers
title: Wait for Codex workers
